metaTitle: LAMÓWKA – Instagram revolutions in the DMs

runs.text: Meta is betting on online safety! 🔐

Meta is taking another step toward protecting users! You can no longer screenshot disappearing messages in Messenger and Instagram. The new feature is meant to stop people from sharing intimate content. On top of that, accounts showing inappropriate behavior will have their contact with minors restricted. That's an important step in the fight against cyberbullying! 🙌
Beauty and horror in one? The new Medicine clothing collection 🎨

Beauty and darkness bleed into each other in the latest collection from Polish fashion label Medicine — a collection inspired by the work of Zdzisław Beksiński. The artist, known for his unsettling, surrealist visions, combined fantasy, horror and existential reflection in his work. The collection, made with the Historical Museum in Sanok, Beksiński's hometown, pays tribute to his singular style. It holds both bold prints drawn from the artist's most famous paintings and subtle nods to his philosophy. It's one for art lovers who want to wear a piece of that fascinating, mysterious reality!
YouTube Shorts gets a Save option! 🎥

YouTube is testing a way to save videos in Shorts, so you can come back to your favorite clips later. The “Dislike” option is being retired, but you'll still be able to like videos. For now the new feature is only available to selected users, so if you don't have it yet — patience! 💾

Instagram never stops building out its platform! Direct messages have picked up new features – from group polls to disappearing photos and videos. What's more, you can now edit a message for 15 minutes after sending it. Perfect for typos! ✨
